blocks.text: Updated 2026-08-13 — the ATP calculation itself is now sourced. In Item Order Plan, Available-to-Promise for a given period is the minimum of Planned Available and Total Demand across that period and every period after it — a shortage anywhere in the future horizon pulls today's ATP down, not just a shortage today. This session's own help is explicit that its ATP figure will not always match the live check run at sales-order entry (different session, cprrp4800m000 ATP Handling, not opened in this recording) — the two use different time buckets, and the order-entry check can include CTP options this planning view does not. So the Item Order Plan screen is directionally correct but not guaranteed to match the number a sales order entry would actually get blocked or allowed on.
